terms.simple: The simplest tax return form, for people with only salary/pension, one house, and other-sources income under Rs 50 lakh total.
terms.why_it_matters: Using the wrong form can make your return invalid or trigger a defective-return notice.
terms.where_in_return: Form selection screen before you start filling details.
terms.hi: यह सबसे आसान टैक्स रिटर्न फॉर्म है, जो केवल वेतन/पेंशन और सीमित अन्य आय वालों के लिए है।

terms.simple: The return form for people with capital gains, multiple house properties, or foreign assets, but no business income.
terms.why_it_matters: Selling shares or mutual funds at a profit means you usually can't use ITR-1 anymore.
terms.where_in_return: Form selection screen.
terms.hi: यह फॉर्म उनके लिए है जिनकी कैपिटल गेन आय है लेकिन बिज़नेस आय नहीं है।

terms.simple: The return form for people with regular business or professional income where you maintain full books of account.
terms.why_it_matters: Needed if you don't use presumptive taxation and track actual profit and loss.
terms.where_in_return: Form selection screen.
terms.hi: यह फॉर्म उन लोगों के लिए है जिनकी नियमित व्यापार या पेशेवर आय है।

terms.simple: The return form for small business owners and professionals using presumptive taxation (44AD/44ADA/44AE).
terms.why_it_matters: Lets freelancers and small businesses skip detailed bookkeeping.
terms.where_in_return: Form selection screen.
terms.hi: यह फॉर्म प्रिज़म्प्टिव टैक्सेशन का उपयोग करने वाले छोटे व्यवसायों और पेशेवरों के लिए है।

terms.simple: A detailed statement showing almost every financial transaction the tax department knows about you -- salary, interest, dividends, share sales, and more.
terms.why_it_matters: If income in AIS doesn't match your return, you may get a notice.
terms.where_in_return: Check before filling in income details; available on the e-filing portal.
terms.hi: एआईएस एक विस्तृत विवरण है जो आपके बारे में टैक्स विभाग को ज्ञात लगभग हर वित्तीय लेनदेन दिखाता है।

terms.simple: A simplified, category-wise summary of the AIS, showing one net figure per income type.
terms.why_it_matters: Easier to use than raw AIS when filling in your return quickly.
terms.where_in_return: Reference document alongside AIS on the e-filing portal.
terms.hi: टीआईएस, एआईएस का एक सरल, श्रेणीवार सारांश है।

terms.simple: A tax-credit statement showing all TDS/TCS deducted against your PAN, plus advance tax and self-assessment tax paid.
terms.why_it_matters: This is the department's record of tax already paid on your behalf -- you can only claim credit for what appears here.
terms.where_in_return: TDS/Taxes Paid schedule.
terms.hi: फॉर्म 26एएस आपके पैन के खिलाफ काटे गए सभी टीडीएस/टीसीएस को दिखाने वाला एक टैक्स-क्रेडिट विवरण है।

terms.simple: A certificate your employer gives you showing your salary, deductions, and TDS deducted for the year.
terms.why_it_matters: It's the primary source document for filling in salary income in ITR-1/2.
terms.where_in_return: Used to pre-fill the Salary schedule.
terms.hi: फॉर्म 16 आपके नियोक्ता द्वारा दिया गया एक प्रमाणपत्र है जो साल भर के वेतन, कटौती और टीडीएस को दिखाता है।

terms.simple: India has two ways to compute your tax -- the 'new regime' (lower rates, fewer deductions) and the 'old regime' (higher rates, more deductions like 80C/HRA).
terms.why_it_matters: Choosing the wrong regime can cost you thousands of rupees in extra tax.
terms.where_in_return: Regime selection option, usually near the start of the return.
terms.hi: भारत में टैक्स की गणना के दो तरीके हैं -- नई व्यवस्था और पुरानी व्यवस्था।

terms.simple: A rebate that can bring your tax down to zero if your total income is below a threshold (Rs 12 lakh new regime, Rs 5 lakh old regime for FY2025-26).
terms.why_it_matters: Many first-time filers with modest income end up owing zero tax because of this rebate.
terms.where_in_return: Automatically applied in the tax computation section.
terms.hi: 87ए छूट आपकी आय एक सीमा से कम होने पर टैक्स को शून्य तक ला सकती है।

terms.simple: A flat deduction from salary/pension income before tax is calculated -- Rs 75,000 under the new regime, Rs 50,000 under the old regime for FY2025-26.
terms.why_it_matters: Applies automatically to everyone with salary/pension income, no proof needed.
terms.where_in_return: Salary schedule, auto-applied once per person per year.
terms.hi: स्टैंडर्ड डिडक्शन वेतन/पेंशन आय से टैक्स गणना से पहले घटाई जाने वाली एक निश्चित राशि है।

terms.simple: A deduction (up to Rs 1,50,000, old regime only) for investments/expenses like EPF, PPF, ELSS, life insurance premium, and children's tuition fees.
terms.why_it_matters: One of the biggest deduction categories available under the old regime.
terms.where_in_return: Chapter VI-A deductions schedule.
terms.hi: 80सी एक कटौती है जो पुरानी व्यवस्था में ईपीएफ, पीपीएफ जैसे निवेशों के लिए उपलब्ध है।

terms.simple: A deduction for health insurance premiums paid for yourself, family, and parents, available only under the old regime.
terms.why_it_matters: Can save significant tax if you pay for health insurance, especially for senior citizen parents.
terms.where_in_return: Chapter VI-A deductions schedule.
terms.hi: 80डी स्वास्थ्य बीमा प्रीमियम के लिए एक कटौती है, जो केवल पुरानी व्यवस्था में उपलब्ध है।

terms.simple: A deduction of up to Rs 10,000 on savings bank account interest, for taxpayers under 60, old regime only.
terms.why_it_matters: Reduces tax on small savings account interest, but doesn't cover FD interest.
terms.where_in_return: Chapter VI-A deductions schedule.
terms.hi: 80टीटीए बचत खाता ब्याज पर 10,000 रुपये तक की कटौती है।

terms.simple: A bigger deduction (up to Rs 50,000) on all bank/post office interest including FDs, only for senior citizens (60+), old regime only.
terms.why_it_matters: Much more generous than 80TTA and specifically helps retirees living off FD interest.
terms.where_in_return: Chapter VI-A deductions schedule.
terms.hi: 80टीटीबी वरिष्ठ नागरिकों के लिए एफडी सहित सभी ब्याज पर 50,000 रुपये तक की कटौती है।

terms.simple: A salary component that can be partly tax-exempt if you pay rent, calculated using a formula involving basic salary, HRA received, and rent paid.
terms.why_it_matters: Only available under the old regime; claiming it under the new regime is an error.
terms.where_in_return: Salary schedule -> exemptions u/s 10(13A).
terms.hi: एचआरए एक वेतन घटक है जो किराया देने पर आंशिक रूप से टैक्स-मुक्त हो सकता है।

terms.simple: Profit from selling an asset held for a short period (for listed shares/equity funds, 12 months or less).
terms.why_it_matters: Taxed at a special flat rate (20% for equity u/s 111A for FY2025-26), not slab rates.
terms.where_in_return: Capital Gains schedule in ITR-2/3.
terms.hi: एसटीसीजी किसी संपत्ति को कम समय के लिए रखने के बाद बेचने से हुआ लाभ है।

terms.simple: Profit from selling an asset held for a longer period (for listed shares/equity funds, more than 12 months).
terms.why_it_matters: Equity LTCG gets a Rs 1,25,000 annual exemption, then taxed at 12.5% for FY2025-26.
terms.where_in_return: Capital Gains schedule in ITR-2/3.
terms.hi: एलटीसीजी किसी संपत्ति को लंबे समय तक रखने के बाद बेचने से हुआ लाभ है।

terms.simple: The rule that taxes long-term capital gains on listed equity shares/equity mutual funds above Rs 1,25,000 a year at 12.5%.
terms.why_it_matters: Determines how much of your equity LTCG is actually taxable.
terms.where_in_return: Capital Gains schedule -> 112A sub-section.
terms.hi: धारा 112ए लिस्टेड इक्विटी शेयरों पर लॉन्ग टर्म कैपिटल गेन को टैक्स करने का नियम है।

terms.simple: The rule that taxes short-term capital gains on listed equity shares/equity mutual funds at a flat 20% (FY2025-26 rate).
terms.why_it_matters: This flat rate applies regardless of your income slab.
terms.where_in_return: Capital Gains schedule -> 111A sub-section.
terms.hi: धारा 111ए लिस्टेड इक्विटी पर शॉर्ट टर्म कैपिटल गेन को एक निश्चित 20% दर पर टैक्स करने का नियम है।

terms.simple: The tax term for cryptocurrency and similar digital assets; gains are taxed flat at 30% with no deduction for expenses (except cost of acquisition) and no loss set-off.
terms.why_it_matters: Crypto gains can't be offset against other losses and are taxed harshly compared to other capital gains.
terms.where_in_return: Schedule VDA in ITR-2/3.
terms.hi: वीडीए क्रिप्टोकरेंसी जैसी डिजिटल संपत्तियों के लिए टैक्स शब्द है, जिस पर 30% फ्लैट टैक्स लगता है।

terms.simple: The final digital confirmation step after filing your return -- without it, your return is treated as not filed.
terms.why_it_matters: Many people file but forget to e-Verify, making their return invalid.
terms.where_in_return: Immediately after submitting the return, or within 30 days.
terms.hi: ई-वेरिफाई रिटर्न भरने के बाद अंतिम डिजिटल पुष्टिकरण चरण है।

terms.simple: The acknowledgement/verification form generated after filing, which can be signed and posted to CPC Bengaluru if you don't e-Verify online.
terms.why_it_matters: An alternative to e-Verify for people without Aadhaar OTP/net banking access.
terms.where_in_return: Downloadable after filing, from the e-filing portal.
terms.hi: आईटीआर-वी फाइलिंग के बाद बनने वाला पावती/सत्यापन फॉर्म है।

terms.simple: The section under which the department sends a 'defective return' notice if your return has certain errors or omissions.
terms.why_it_matters: You must respond within the given time or your return is treated as if it was never filed.
terms.where_in_return: Notice received via e-Proceedings, not part of the original filing.
terms.hi: धारा 139(9) के तहत विभाग गलत या अधूरे रिटर्न पर 'डिफेक्टिव रिटर्न' नोटिस भेजता है।

terms.simple: The first automated processing of your return by CPC, resulting in an intimation showing either a refund, a demand, or 'no adjustment'.
terms.why_it_matters: This is usually the first official response you get after filing -- always read it carefully.
terms.where_in_return: Received after processing, not part of the original filing.
terms.hi: धारा 143(1) सीपीसी द्वारा आपके रिटर्न की पहली स्वचालित प्रोसेसिंग है।

terms.simple: A return filed after the original due date but before the final late-filing deadline, usually with a late fee.
terms.why_it_matters: Still lets you file (with a penalty), but you lose the ability to carry forward most losses.
terms.where_in_return: Return filing type selection.
terms.hi: विलंबित रिटर्न वह रिटर्न है जो मूल नियत तारीख के बाद लेकिन अंतिम समय सीमा से पहले दाखिल किया जाता है।

terms.simple: A corrected version of a return you already filed, replacing it entirely, filed before the deadline for revision.
terms.why_it_matters: Lets you fix genuine errors or omissions without penalty (unlike ITR-U).
terms.where_in_return: Return filing type selection -> 'Revised u/s 139(5)'.
terms.hi: संशोधित रिटर्न पहले दाखिल किए गए रिटर्न का सही किया हुआ संस्करण है।

terms.simple: A return you can file up to 4 years after the assessment year to correct omissions, but only to increase tax liability (with extra fees) never to claim a refund.
terms.why_it_matters: A safety net for people who realise later they missed reporting some income.
terms.where_in_return: Return filing type selection -> 'Updated u/s 139(8A)'.
terms.hi: आईटीआर-यू एक अद्यतन रिटर्न है जो कर देयता बढ़ाने के लिए दाखिल किया जा सकता है।

terms.simple: A unique number stamped on every official communication from the Income Tax Department, used to verify it's genuine.
terms.why_it_matters: Any notice without a valid DIN should be treated as suspicious/fake.
terms.where_in_return: Printed on all notices/orders; verifiable on the e-filing portal.
terms.hi: डीआईएन हर आधिकारिक टैक्स नोटिस पर छपा एक विशिष्ट नंबर है।

terms.simple: A 10-character number every entity that deducts TDS must have, distinct from PAN.
terms.why_it_matters: Shown on Form 16/16A and used to identify which employer/payer deducted your tax.
terms.where_in_return: Form 16 Part A, Form 26AS deductor list.
terms.hi: टैन हर उस संस्था के लिए ज़रूरी 10-अंकों की संख्या है जो टीडीएस काटती है।

terms.simple: The process of confirming a bank account on the e-filing portal so it's eligible to receive tax refunds.
terms.why_it_matters: Refunds cannot be credited to an account that isn't prevalidated.
terms.where_in_return: 'My Bank Account' section of the e-filing profile.
terms.hi: प्रीवैलिडेशन बैंक खाते की पुष्टि करने की प्रक्रिया है ताकि वह रिफंड पाने के योग्य हो।

terms.simple: An additional 4% charge on your total tax (and surcharge, if any), earmarked for health and education spending.
terms.why_it_matters: Always added on top of your computed tax -- easy to forget when estimating your liability.
terms.where_in_return: Tax computation summary, added after basic tax.
terms.hi: सेस आपके कुल टैक्स पर एक अतिरिक्त 4% शुल्क है।

terms.simple: An extra charge on tax for high-income taxpayers, applying only above certain income thresholds (starts above Rs 50 lakh).
terms.why_it_matters: Not relevant for most first-time or middle-income filers, but significant for high earners.
terms.where_in_return: Tax computation summary.
terms.hi: अधिभार उच्च आय वाले करदाताओं के लिए टैक्स पर एक अतिरिक्त शुल्क है।

terms.simple: A simplified scheme where you declare a fixed percentage of your gross receipts as income (8-6% for business u/s44AD, 50% for specified professionals u/s44ADA) instead of tracking actual expenses.
terms.why_it_matters: Saves freelancers and small businesses from maintaining detailed books of account.
terms.where_in_return: Business/Profession schedule in ITR-4.
terms.hi: प्रिज़म्प्टिव टैक्सेशन एक सरल योजना है जिसमें सकल प्राप्तियों का एक निश्चित प्रतिशत आय के रूप में घोषित किया जाता है।

terms.simple: The TDS section under which payers deduct tax (typically 10%) on fees paid for professional or technical services.
terms.why_it_matters: Often applied to freelance/consulting payments and sometimes, debatably, to internship stipends.
terms.where_in_return: Reflected in AIS/26AS as a TDS entry; doesn't by itself decide which ITR form to use.
terms.hi: धारा 194जे पेशेवर या तकनीकी सेवाओं के लिए भुगतान पर टीडीएस काटने का प्रावधान है।

terms.simple: The TDS section under which banks/others deduct tax (typically 10%) on interest income other than savings account interest, e.g. FD interest.
terms.why_it_matters: Explains why your bank deducted tax on your fixed deposit interest.
terms.where_in_return: Reflected in AIS/26AS/Form 26AS as a TDS entry.
terms.hi: धारा 194ए बैंक जमा जैसे ब्याज आय पर टीडीएस काटने का प्रावधान है।

terms.simple: The section under which companies/RTAs deduct TDS (typically 10%) on dividend payments above Rs 5,000 in a year from a single payer.
terms.why_it_matters: Small dividends (under Rs 5,000 from one company) usually have no TDS, but are still taxable income.
terms.where_in_return: Reflected in AIS as SFT-015 and, if TDS applies, in Form 26AS.
terms.hi: धारा 194 के तहत कंपनियां एक वित्तीय वर्ष में 5,000 रुपये से अधिक के डिविडेंड पर टीडीएस काटती हैं।

terms.simple: The sum of income from all five heads (salary, house property, business/profession, capital gains, other sources) before any Chapter VI-A deductions.
terms.why_it_matters: Deductions like 80C/80D are subtracted from GTI to arrive at Total Income.
terms.where_in_return: Computed automatically in the 'Total Income' section.
terms.hi: सकल कुल आय (जीटीआई) चैप्टर VI-ए कटौतियों से पहले सभी पांच आय के स्रोतों का योग है।

terms.simple: Gross Total Income minus all eligible Chapter VI-A deductions -- the figure your tax is actually calculated on.
terms.why_it_matters: This, not your salary or CTC, is the number that determines your tax slab.
terms.where_in_return: Computed automatically, shown just before the tax computation.
terms.hi: कुल आय (कर योग्य आय) जीटीआई में से सभी पात्र कटौतियों को घटाने के बाद बचती है।

terms.simple: Tax paid in installments during the financial year (rather than as a lump sum at filing) when your total tax liability exceeds Rs 10,000 after TDS.
terms.why_it_matters: Missing advance tax installments attracts interest under sections 234B/234C.
terms.where_in_return: Taxes Paid schedule; also visible in Form 26AS as Type 'Advance Tax'.
terms.hi: अग्रिम कर वित्तीय वर्ष के दौरान किश्तों में भुगतान किया जाने वाला कर है।

terms.simple: Any remaining tax you pay yourself at the time of filing, after accounting for TDS and advance tax already paid.
terms.why_it_matters: You must pay this before filing, or your return may be treated as defective.
terms.where_in_return: Taxes Paid schedule -> Self-Assessment Tax (Challan 280).
terms.hi: स्व-निर्धारण कर वह शेष कर है जो आप रिटर्न दाखिल करते समय स्वयं भुगतान करते हैं।

terms.simple: Reports that banks, brokers, and other entities file with the tax department about specified high-value transactions, which feed into your AIS.
terms.why_it_matters: This is how the department knows about your dividends, share sales, and large deposits even before you file.
terms.where_in_return: Underlying source of most AIS entries (e.g. SFT-015 for dividend, SFT-017/018 for securities).
terms.hi: एसएफटी बैंकों और ब्रोकरों द्वारा दाखिल की जाने वाली रिपोर्ट है जो एआईएस में फीड होती है।
